references.text: The neighbors ask the same question about his identity ("Is this not he?"), and the man confirms that he is the same one who previously sat and begged, but who is now healed.
The parents explicitly confirm that the boy is their son and that he was blind, which mirrors the neighbors' confirmation that the man was the same beggar they knew.
The man himself confirms to the Pharisees that he is the same person who was previously blind and that he can now see, which is the core of the debate that began with the neighbors' question.
